summary: Round 6 focused test for two fixes: (FIX1) Profile 'View public profile' opens /u/<id>?preview=1 and respects hide_followers/hide_following as a non-self viewer, and (FIX2) new user registration auto-creates one private DRAFT welcome blog post. Backend pytest suite (10 tests) all pass. Frontend Playwright verified all three preview cases (hide_followers only, hide_following only, no flags) plus welcome draft creation & privacy.
critical_code_review_comments: Known dev-only hydration warning: <span> inside <option> (Feed.jsx select with dynamic option children). Tooling noise per main agent, not a bug.
backend create_welcome_post is idempotent-by-design only on register (not on subsequent logins) which matches the spec (exactly ONE welcome draft per user).
test_credentials: teacher@teachhub.com / teacher12345 (restored hide_followers=false, hide_following=false after tests)
seed_data_creation: Created several throwaway TEST_wc_*@example.com users (each auto-gets one welcome draft). Restored teacher privacy flags to false.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Round 6 fixes verified end-to-end. Preview UI: /u/<id>?preview=1 correctly shows preview-banner, hides stat-followers+pp-tab-followers when hide_followers=true, hides stat-following+pp-tab-following when hide_following=true.
